sql:
create temp table snapshot_test (
	nr	integer,
	snap	txid_snapshot
)
shape: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE snapshot_test (nr integer, snap txid_snapshot);

sql: select snap from snapshot_test order by nr
shape: SELECT snap FROM snapshot_test ORDER BY nr;

sql:
select  txid_snapshot_xmin(snap),
	txid_snapshot_xmax(snap),
	txid_snapshot_xip(snap)
from snapshot_test order by nr
shape: SELECT txid_snapshot_xmin(snap), txid_snapshot_xmax(snap), txid_snapshot_xip(snap) FROM snapshot_test ORDER BY nr;

sql:
select id, txid_visible_in_snapshot(id, snap)
from snapshot_test, generate_series(11, 21) id
where nr = 2
shape: SELECT id, txid_visible_in_snapshot(id, snap) FROM snapshot_test, generate_series(11, 21) AS id WHERE nr = 2;
